_comment: Reference settings for the read-only GitHub App used by the collector. Organization scope: create the App under the organization (Settings › Developer settings › GitHub Apps › New GitHub App) or POST this manifest to https://github.com/organizations/<ORG>/settings/apps/new. Enterprise scope: create an enterprise-owned App (Enterprise settings › GitHub Apps) with only 'Enterprise Copilot metrics: Read' – remove the organization_* permissions. Remove organization_administration if you set collect.billing: false. Verify with: npm run auth:check
name: Copilot Maturity Dashboard
description: Reads GitHub Copilot usage metrics for the Copilot Maturity Dashboard (read-only).
